authorization_and_data_review: The one native catalog remains authoritative; fresh catalog checks precede cursor/data processing. Trusted internal backend key is not accepted from external callers; exact finite route/parameter allowlists, duplicate/prototype-key rejection and no positive cache protect the adapter. No secondary grants/tokens/schema authority introduced.

The query compiler uses typed validated AST, fixed schema/column allowlists, bound values, actual PostgreSQL bbox/predicate/order/aggregate work and bounded page+1 transfer. Read-only query role cannot mutate snapshots or read token tables. All seven SQL fields are fetched; projected output is not SQL projection pushdown.

Native keyset cursor binds credential HMAC plus resource and full normalized query/revisions/projection, with unique tie-breaker and NULLS LAST. Actual changed-principal test has two authorized callers: fixture-outsider owns group_points, reader has group grant; actual response is400INVALID_CURSOR. This is credential binding, not a catalog policy-revision claim. C1 OFFSET requires explicit immutable revision and may scan prefixes.

Actual owner fixture insert creates another revision between page requests; it demonstrates snapshot selection, not simultaneous transaction concurrency. Real database lock contention separately exercises deadline behavior.

UTF8 body/form parsing,32KiB input and2MiB streaming response limits, finite JSON-only output, precise field vocabulary/nullability and default-capability projection are reviewed. Runtime evidence observed max101 fetched rows; it is not a1000-row-capacity or arbitrary client conformance claim.
resolved_findings: Native JSON bytes previously allowed UTF16/32 via json.loads; final decoder requires strictUTF8 and actual malformedUTF8/UTF16 requests reject.
Permission positives previously could accept invalid_json marker as success; final tests require status and expected mode-shaped results.

Actual002 revealed wrong timestamp/type/nullability output from first-party esriFieldType input vocabulary and missing nullable declarations. Reading unchanged codec mapping showed correct provider Integer/Double/Date/GUID/String names; corrected adapter now passes exact output tests. Failed002 is not evidence of an unchanged-codec defect.

Intermediate003 error envelopes were incomplete. Final complete versioned safe envelopes validate against approveda31 schema, distinguish policy/backend/lock failures and reject unknown methods without inherited HTML/trace echoes.
Actual authority-outage matrix now covers native/C1 feature/count/extent and C1 metadata, with no SQL growth.

Root identified contradictory broad supportsAdvancedQueries=false plus supportsOrderBy=true. Final finite profile omits the broad flag, retaining explicit tested per-operation flags and unqualified named-client discovery.
Extracted Node originally lacked runtime before/after archive comparison; final guard verifies actual file bytes/modes/links and rejects a changed binary, with fresh005 execution.

boundaries: Read-only independent review; no source edits, remote writes, settings changes, production deployment, new repository or external messaging. Only private review receipts written.

Owned PostgreSQL15.19/PostGIS3.5.7 and actual native GeoNode OAuth/catalog used in controlled synthetic fixture; existing reviewed PostgreSQL setsid exception explicit. Loopback supervisor is not a hostile filesystem/process sandbox. All services/DB stop, synthetic credentials invalidated/config scrubbed.

Public evidence contains hashes/paths and bounded observations; private configuration, keys, raw diagnostic logs and actual credential material are not committed. Raw SQL plans contain synthetic values and are not a production logging design.
